Use case: stylized-concept. Production standalone 2D side-scrolling RPG village SHOP building on genuine transparent RGBA background. Strict clean hand-crafted 16-bit pixel art, hard square pixels, restricted warm earthy palette, dark readable outlines, no blur/no antialias/no gradients/no UI/no watermark/no letters or words. A welcoming low two-storey timber and stone village apothecary shop, broad terracotta red tiled roof and one little chimney, cream plaster and oak beams, open wooden central doorway, striped ochre and cream canvas awning, warm lit square windows, wooden hanging sign displaying a recognizable bright ruby red potion bottle icon, crates and jars beside door. FRONT elevation, full building, ample transparent margins, flat stone foundation at bottom. Building is WIDE and LOW, about 5:4 aspect, complete roof and base visible. No clock, no tower, no spire, no landscape, no people. Readable at native 160x128 pixel scale and 3x integer display. Matches cozy medieval fantasy village.
